lines.en: label iodorm35:
scene iovisityuki1
I decide to spend the night with Io in hopes that, this time, I’ll be able to make it at least an hour or two in without making her uncomfortable.
It should be a little easier now that she’s outright told me about her aversion to [[the good kind of] physical contact, but that doesn’t mean I won’t figure out a way to ruin things regardless.
Because, to be fair, she’s dropped plenty of hints about this exact thing so far and it has changed literally nothing about my actions- but that ends today.
Or rather, it ended last time we talked. But also today.
Anyway, here comes Io.
scene iovisityuki2
: Greetings, Master! Party of one? Our specials today are smiles and love. And also the new deluxe strawberry parfait Osako-chan just came up with for the low, low cost of 2,000 yen.
: Has the cafe somehow gone bankrupt and been relocated to your dorm room?
scene iovisityuki3
: As if we’d ever go bankrupt with how much time you spend there, Master. You’re basically subsidizing Uta-chan’s entire livelihood at this point.
: Well, if the cafe isn’t here, why are you in Uta-chan mode?
: Beats me. I don’t always get to choose when I switch back and forth. What brings you over, though? Which one of us are you lookin’ for, you sly dog you?
: Io.
scene iovisityuki4
: Man, you couldn’t even lie to me?
: Sorry, there’s just something I wanted to talk to her about that I probably shouldn’t involve you in at this point in time.
: Well, what the heck is it? We don’t keep secrets in this household. Out with it, Master.
: Oh, you know. Just that quirky character trait of hers where she wants me to have sex with her best friend so we can all live happily ever after.
scene iovisityuki5
: She actually told you about that?!
if day <= 5:
: Also, what the heck do you think you’re sayin’ in the middle of the hallway on a weekday?! Someone could hear you!
: I take it you were just as surprised to hear about this as I was?
scene iovisityuki6
: Oh! Not at all, Sensei! I thought it was totally friggin’ normal that girl-hating Io was randomly cool with the idea of a throuple! I wasn’t surprised at all!
scene iovisityuki7
: That set your sarcasm detector off? Cause it should’ve.
: I have no idea what that girl’s been on lately. But whatever it is, her dosage needs to get halved cause this whole throuple thing is just crazy talk. The heck does she think she’s proposing?
: I take it you’re not a fan of the idea, then?
scene iovisityuki8
: Course I’m not a fan of the idea.
: I get where it’s coming from, but...I don’t know. What she wants just seems all sorts of wrong to me. There’s no way something like that could work out without one of us getting hurt.
: Gotcha. So it’s not the having sex with me part you’re not cool with, it’s the Io part.
scene iovisityuki9
: Huh? What? Huh? Me? You? Huh?
scene iovisityuki10
: A-Anyway! Io was going over to Yuki’s place tonight and...I’ve got lots of homework to do, so...it’d probably be best if you just...you know...didn’t come inside.
scene iovisityuki9
: The room! Didn’t come inside the room! Not...Not Uta-chan.
: I knew what you meant, Uta.
: Uta-chan. Regular Uta’s not home. Cause she’d definitely never say any of this weird stuff that the customer service oriented version is saying.
scene iovisityuki11
: Anyway! Have a nice day! Or night! And don’t come anywhere you’re not supposed to! Bye!
scene iovisityuki1
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!
: WHY DID I SAY THAT?!?!?!
: You know I can still hear you in there, right?
: No you can’t! Go away!
scene black
With nothing else to do and Io nowhere to be found, I decide to head home for the night.
But only after embarrassing the one resident of Dorm 7 that I don’t have to be careful with.
It’s definitely strange hearing that Uta is the one who has issues with Io’s “arrangement,” though.
If you’d have asked me several months ago, I would have assumed it to be the other way around.
And while it’s true that both of them have rejected my advances, it seems like only one of them is forcing themselves to.
The other is just defective.
Meanwhile...
scene iovisityuki12
: I didn’t overdo it, did I?
: No. No way. I mean, this is Yuki we’re talking about. I highly doubt she’s actually cooking herself balanced meals every night.
scene iovisityuki13
: But, then again, this is weird. I’m being weird. She didn’t even invite me over and now I have enough groceries to fill her fridge.
: Wait...does she even have a fridge? Should I just try and return all of this stuff? Does the grocery store even accept returns?
scene iovisityuki14
: Damn it, Io. Can you do anything right at all? You’re just going to make Yuki think you’re awkward and-
: But...wait. You are awkward. So why is having someone think you’re awkward bad when allowing them to think otherwise would only screw up their expectations and-
: You know what? Maybe I’ll just go home. I can always try again next week. And I’m kind of tired anyway, so-
: Hm?
scene iovisityuki15
: Hm?
scene nightsky
: You look kinda familiar...
: I’m not. You probably have me confused with someone else.
: I’ll be on my way n-
: Nah, hold up a sec.
scene iovisityuki16
: Ain’t we in the same class or whatever?
: No. I’ll be leaving now.
: The fuck you lyin’ to me for? You’re, uhh...Ito, right? Or was it...Iro?
: Iori?
scene iovisityuki17
: You know what? Come to think of it, we are in the same class. I just don’t normally see you in there.
: And it’s Io, by the way. We had an entire contest thing against each other...Ring any bells?
: Not really. The fuck you doin’ over here for, though? You live in this dump or some shit?
scene iovisityuki18
: I was visiting someone. Or...trying to at least.
: Friend of yours? Boyfriend? Family?
scene iovisityuki19
: Do you forcefully interrogate everyone you meet for the first time? Or...?
: Oh, no. My bad. I just...ain’t really used to strikin’ up conversations and shit.
: Then why strike one up with me? I probably hate people even more than you do.
: Just...seemed like you were havin’ a shitty night. That’s all. I’ll leave you alone if you want.
scene iovisityuki20
: Ugh...fuck my life.
: Aren’t you supposed to be harder to talk to or something? Why do you seem so...weirdly rational?
scene iovisityuki21
: Beats the fuck outta me. I ain’t really known for my rationality after all. But it ain’t like I’m just gonna go around startin’ problems with people for no reason whatsoever.
: The old me might’a done that shit, but I ain’t really like that anymore. I’ve like...grown or something. Whatever the fuck they call it.
: Do you...want me to congratulate you? Because that's not going to happen.
scene iovisityuki22
: Not really. But if you wanna come inside and chill for a little while, you can.

: Ain’t my apartment, but I’ve got a key and shit. And it’ll give you a chance to rest or whatever before you finish chickening out on bringing all that shit to...wherever the fuck you were tryin’ to bring it.
: Uhh...
: Yeah, I’m probably just gonna finish chickening out instead. I’ve seen what you can do to people and I’d prefer to not have my teeth punched in, thanks.
scene iovisityuki23
: I ain’t gonna lay a finger on you, don’t worry.
: Learned my lesson last time. Hit the wrong person at the wrong time once and it’s like throwin’ away everything you’ve worked for.
: And it ain’t like I have shit to begin with now that I’m startin’ over again, but...still. I ain’t gonna touch you.
: Don’t fuck with me and I won’t fuck with you. That’s my new policy. Do with that whatever the fuck you will. Doesn’t make a difference to me.
scene black
: Ugh...fine. Okay.
: But...just for a few minutes.
scene iovisityuki24
: Well...here we are. Welcome to Casa Del Shithole.
: Wow...Yuki’s place is actually a lot nicer than I thought it would be.
: Yeah. She ain’t-
scene iovisityuki25
: Wait, what’d you just say?
: Oh! Uhh...that...your place is a lot nicer than I thought it would be.
: Really? Cause I could’a sworn you-
: I think I know what I said, thanks.
scene iovisityuki26
: R...Right. Well, as I was sayin’ before, this ain’t my place. I just come here to eat food and crash on the couch whenever I’m in the area.
: And I’ve been, like...lookin’ for jobs and shit around here, so I’ve been around a lot lately.

: Figured it’d be easy findin’ somethin’ over here since it’s, like...what do you call it...a low-income area or something? I don’t know. This is where the poor people chill, basically. So I’m right at home.
: It’s not that bad. I kind of like it.

: Yeah, you ain’t had to deal with the sirens and trains and shit in the middle of the night yet. Or the busted ass AC or how the windows get stuck when you try and open ‘em to get rid of all the smoke.
: I guess not...
scene iovisityuki27
: Is there a fridge I can put all this stuff in? I don’t want it getting cold.
: Then why the fuck would you put it in the fridge?
: That’s-
: Wait, hold on. No. I meant I...don’t want it getting cold...naturally?
: What?
: Can you just tell me where the fucking fridge is?
: Behind me and to the left. Mind grabbin’ me a water while you’re in there?
scene black
: Are you incapable of getting one yourself? What about the nine thousand half-empty water bottles lying around the room? Will one of them work?
: Ew, no. I can’t remember which ones are mine and I’ll be damned if I accidentally trade spit with some bitch who’s probably got every disease known to man.
: Boo-hoo. Woe is you.
: The fuck’s your deal? Just get me a damn water. You can take one too if you want.
: I just think you should be a little less generous when it comes to giving away someone else’s stuff when none of this is yours to hand out in the first place.
: And I think you should dye your hair a normal fuckin’ color but you don’t see me preachin’ that with every single step you take.
scene iovisityuki28
: Touche. Also, whoops. Forgot your water.
: You didn’t forget shit, you little brat. You did that on purpose.
: If you want water, you can buy your own or use the faucet. Someone worked for what’s in that fridge and it’s not fair if someone else just takes it.
: Use the faucet? In a place like this? Would be safer to drink my own piss. ‘Sides, the bitch who lives here owes me. She can go without a bottle or two.
: Owes you for what exactly?
scene iovisityuki29
: Oh, not much. Only scarring me for life and shit like that. You know how it is.

: Or maybe you don’t. Ain’t got a clue what your fuckin’ background is- just that it probably ain’t hard to connect the dots in figurin’ out where you and me are on the social ladder based on context clues.
scene iovisityuki30
: Yeah...I guess you're right about that.
: So what’s your deal? Where’s that “fuck the world” attitude come from? Shit like that doesn’t just happen on its own. Know that from experience.
: I’d prefer not talking about myself with people I don’t know very well.
: Shit like that is what makes it impossible to get to know somebody in the first place, but...
: Fair enough. Just trying to make shit less quiet. And it seems like the only things we’ve got in common are bein’ stuck in here and the fact that we’ve got the same douchebag teacher.
: Sensei’s not a douchebag. He’s a good person.
: Sure, if your idea of being a good person is hooking up with children and getting paid to neglect your responsibilities all day long.
: No one’s perfect. We’re probably just as fucked up as he is when it really comes down to it.
: But we’re also teenagers. We ain’t supposed to be perfect.
: This is the age where we’re supposed to be fuckin’ around and findin’ shit out as we go. That dude’s fuckin’ doubled our lives and he still hasn’t gotten that shit down yet.
: So what? Neither has your mom apparently and you’re still coming here to mooch off of her. Some people take longer to fully develop than others.
: And some people never fully develop at all.
scene iovisityuki31

: From one fuck-up to another, you ever worry that you’ll end up like that? That school will end before you’ve ever figured out a direction you’re supposed to head in and that it’ll all just...burn to the ground after that?
: Think? No. I’ve already accepted that fate.
: Why? We’re young as shit. Feelin’ sorry for ourselves is only gonna wind up hurting the people we care about further down the line.
: You say that as if I have anyone I actually care about.
: Don’t you?
scene iovisityuki32
: You’re close with that loudmouth girl, ain’t ya? The short one who sucks at arm wrestling.
: Uta? Yeah. She’s the only girl I actually like.
: Then wouldn’t you feel like shit letting her down and not doin’ anything with your life?
: Not really. She knows better than to expect anything out of me. And I doubt I’ll wind up even making it to 30 in the first place.
: What? You ain’t, like...thinkin’ of killin’ yourself or some shit, are you? Cause if I just accidentally prevented a suicide, that’s pretty fuckin-
: I’m not going to do something like that. I’m way too afraid of not knowing what comes next.
: It’s just a feeling I have, really. There’s no rhyme or reason to it.
: Huh...
scene iovisityuki33
: Well, that’s fuckin’ dumb.

: I never said it wasn’t. All I said was that it’s a feeling I have. And with that in mind, it’s no different from wasting your time worrying whether or not you’ll wind up as someone’s definition of a failure.
: How so?
: Well...life is just a whole bunch of feelings at the end of the day. Right?
: We get happy when good things happen...or sad when shitty things happen. All we’re really doing is reacting to the world around us doing its...shitty world stuff.
: And so, when you start to think about it like that, nothing we do matters in the first place.

: Like, yeah, we can work hard and set goals and shit. We can make our dreams come true. But there’s so much happening around us that we have no influence over that it makes those goals seem kind of sucky.
: I ain’t gettin’ it. How’s that make thinkin’ you’re a failure the same thing as thinkin’ you’re gonna die at an early age?
: Well, it’s like...not everybody has the same idea of what it means to...fail, I guess? And they’re both...things you can never really know for sure? Does that make sense?
: Not really. Sounds to me like you’re just talkin’ outta your ass.
scene iovisityuki34
: Ha...maybe you’re right.
: Maybe I am just talking out of my ass.
: But when you never learn how to properly express yourself, things like...explaining your feelings or opinions become a lot like mazes.
: And even the people who make mazes aren’t immune to getting stuck in them. We all need to fail or get lost and shit and...some people can work through that while others just give up.
: And you’re one of those “give-up” types, I guess?
scene iovisityuki35
: I guess.
: Which means you’re the other one?
: I guess.
: Ain’t nothin’ to write home about though when I still ain’t done shit.
: Not like I have anyone to write to in the first place.
: Same here.
: Truth is...I’ve only just started talkin’ to my mom again after all the shit she put me through when I was little.
: ...What?
: It’s like...that whole “never learning how to express yourself” thing you brought up a second ago.
: That was me too. Or...is me. Which is probably why I also only have, like...one friend.
: My mom was a hardcore junkie.
: She walked out on me when I was really little and I had to...pretty much grow up without parents since my dad was always busy with...work.
: Wasn’t easy...but I made it this far without anyone’s help, so I guess that’s somethin’ to be proud of or whatever.
: And, you know...I think I was doin’ pretty okay until she walked back into my life. Like, yeah, I was an asshole and a bully and shit...but I’m still kind of those things now, so...
: I just don’t get how someone can disappear for so long and then just...try to patch things up. Makes my whole struggle growin’ up seem like it was all for nothing.
: Like she got to take the easy road while I bashed my head against the fuckin’ wall hopin’ that one day I’d-
: Pfft...
scene iovisityuki36
: Pfft!
: Hahah...haha...hahahah!!!
scene iovisityuki37
: Are you...
: Are you...laughing at me?...
scene iovisityuki38
: That’s your tragic backstory?
: Your mom wasn’t there? And now she is again?
: That’s all it took to break you?
: Wha-
: Are you kidding? You are. You have to be. Am I really not supposed to laugh at that?
: It’s not funny!
: Oh, I know.
: It’s fucking hilarious.
: Who...
: Who the fuck do you think you are, talking to me like that?! You ain’t got the faintest idea of the shit that I’ve been through!
scene iovisityuki39
: I would have killed for what you’ve been through.
: You...what?...
: Do you know what I got instead?
: Tell me.
: Do you know what I got instead?
: Good.
scene black
: You don’t want to.
